items.html: And behold, through the five Gevurot of Ima, which are drawn to the Nukva of ZA, into the Malchut within her, as above, these judgments are sweetened. And it is known that Ima is called Ehyeh; therefore the five Gevurot within her are in the secret of Ehyeh, and these are drawn, in the secret of the five Alephs of the five [letters of] Ehyeh, down to the Malchut of the Nukva, and they join with the five times Din that is within her, becoming the five names of Adonai. And the five Dins are sweetened with these five Alephs, which are the five times light [Or] mentioned in the account of creation, which are in Ima, as is known. And when they were sweetened, she is called ‘a young woman with He,’ whose gematria is three hundred and twenty-five, corresponding to the count of five times Adonai, which are the sweetened judgments. And then, being a young woman, she received the yoke of the male and is fit for the coupling, as mentioned in Parashat Bo, page 38, column 2. And this is, ‘Drink, and be drunk, O beloved ones,’ for ‘beloved ones’ [Dodim] has the gematria of Din, and in the secret of these three hundred and twenty [sparks], which are the discernment of five times Din, is the coupling of ZON, who are called ‘beloved ones.’
